body:
## What it does

Everything is scored P0, P1 or P2 with an evidence URL attached, and each month is diffed against the last so you see what moved rather than a fresh wall of findings. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @scheemunai shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
